actual_outcome.scope: Exact full hol-guard-runtime binary unit populations on Linux x86_64 under Rust1.88.0, separately default and diagnostic-phases. Default lists192 (187 original+5 new), expects190 pass and2 existing ignored; diagnostic-phases lists205 (200 original+5 new), expects203 pass and2 existing ignored. Each new real-socket control executes once per feature build. The two existing ignored diagnostic bodies, diagnostic-allocations feature, four package-lock example tests and non-Linux tests are outside this binary-body workload. Workspace all-targets default clippy and runtime all-targets diagnostic-phases clippy compile broader source. Direct full-workspace rustfmt --check preserves source without normalization; any quality failure is retained and remains a final failure while independent unit evidence is attempted. Actual collection must match the frozen source-derived complete nodes. All production/error/cleanup/test deadlines remain unchanged. No installed-native latency, Ubuntu startup cause, Windows, release, merge or overall PRD qualification claim.
